column4: Morph-It lists sete/site (archaic) and siate; the standard voi imperative of essere is siate — our subjunctive-based form.
disparire admits both the -isc- conjugation (disparisce) and the plain one (dispare); Morph-It carries only the plain forms.
Morph-It's spiobbeno/spioverno are dialectal; spiovvero (and regular spioverono) are standard.
travisto and traveduto are both attested; Morph-It lists only the -uto form.
Same doublet as travedere.
